fruits.extendedStory: Aron Johansson drew it, and it opened in 1905 on Helgeandsholmen. Then the members moved out. From 1971 the island stood empty while they sat in borrowed rooms at Kulturhuset by Sergels torg. They came back in 1983, to a rebuilt house on the same ground. The parliament calls its own building neo-Baroque, with Art Nouveau rooms inside.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Aron Johansson entwarf es, 1905 wurde es auf Helgeandsholmen eröffnet. Dann zogen die Abgeordneten aus. Ab 1971 stand die Insel leer, während sie im Kulturhuset am Sergels torg in geliehenen Räumen tagten. 1983 kamen sie zurück, in ein umgebautes Haus am selben Ort. Das Parlament nennt den Stil seines Hauses selbst Neobarock, mit Jugendstil in den Räumen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Aron Johansson drew it, and it opened in 1905 on Helgeandsholmen. Then the members moved out. From 1971 the island stood empty while they sat in borrowed rooms at Kulturhuset by Sergels torg. They came back in 1983, to a rebuilt house on the same ground. The parliament calls its own building neo-Baroque, with Art Nouveau rooms inside.

localizedStory.de: Das Parlament ließ dieses Haus 1971 leer stehen und kehrte erst 1983 zurück.
localizedStory.en: Parliament left this house standing empty in 1971 and came back to it in 1983.

fruits.name: Riksdagshuset
fruits.story: Parliament left this house standing empty in 1971 and came back to it in 1983.

fruits.extendedStory: A fire on 7 May 1697 took almost all of the old Tre Kronor castle. Six weeks later Nicodemus Tessin the Younger handed in his drawings for a new palace. He reckoned on five years of work. The royal family did not move back in until 1754. What they returned to is the baroque palace in front of you, and it is still a workplace.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Am 7. Mai 1697 zerstörte ein Feuer fast das ganze alte Schloss Tre Kronor. Sechs Wochen später reichte Nicodemus Tessin der Jüngere seine Zeichnungen für einen Neubau ein. Er rechnete mit fünf Jahren. Die königliche Familie zog erst 1754 wieder ein. Was sie vorfand, ist der Barockbau vor dir, und er ist bis heute ein Arbeitsplatz.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A fire on 7 May 1697 took almost all of the old Tre Kronor castle. Six weeks later Nicodemus Tessin the Younger handed in his drawings for a new palace. He reckoned on five years of work. The royal family did not move back in until 1754. What they returned to is the baroque palace in front of you, and it is still a workplace.

localizedStory.de: Über 600 Zimmer auf elf Stockwerken, und hinter den Fenstern gehen König und Königin noch immer zur Arbeit.
localizedStory.en: More than 600 rooms on eleven floors, and behind those windows the King and Queen still go to work.

fruits.name: Stockholms slott
fruits.story: More than 600 rooms on eleven floors, and behind those windows the King and Queen still go to work.

fruits.extendedStory: The church opened in 1306 and carries the name of Saint Nicholas. Kings were crowned under this roof, and princes and princesses were married here, century after century. Even so, it did not become a cathedral with a bishop of its own until the 1940s. The carved group inside is medieval, made of wood, and it is the largest wooden sculpture in Europe. It is worth a slow circle.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Kirche wurde 1306 eröffnet und trägt den Namen des heiligen Nikolaus. Unter diesem Dach wurden Könige gekrönt, Prinzen und Prinzessinnen heirateten hier, Jahrhundert für Jahrhundert. Domkirche mit eigenem Bischof wurde sie trotzdem erst in den 1940er Jahren. Die Figurengruppe drinnen ist mittelalterlich, aus Holz geschnitten, und die größte Holzskulptur Europas. Sie lohnt eine langsame Runde.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The church opened in 1306 and carries the name of Saint Nicholas. Kings were crowned under this roof, and princes and princesses were married here, century after century. Even so, it did not become a cathedral with a bishop of its own until the 1940s. The carved group inside is medieval, made of wood, and it is the largest wooden sculpture in Europe. It is worth a slow circle.

localizedStory.de: Drinnen steht der heilige Georg mit dem Drachen, im Mittelalter aus Holz geschnitten und die größte Holzskulptur Europas.
localizedStory.en: Inside stands St George and the Dragon, cut from wood in the Middle Ages and the largest wooden sculpture in Europe.

fruits.name: Storkyrkan
fruits.story: Inside stands St George and the Dragon, cut from wood in the Middle Ages and the largest wooden sculpture in Europe.

fruits.extendedStory: The museum opened in 2001, the year the Nobel Prize turned one hundred. Its home is the Börshuset on Stortorget, and it takes the ground floor. Directly above are the rooms of the Swedish Academy. Alfred Nobel gave his name to the prize, and the prize gave its name to the museum. All of it on one square in the old town.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Museum wurde 2001 eröffnet, in dem Jahr, in dem der Nobelpreis hundert wurde. Sein Haus ist das Börshuset am Stortorget, und es nimmt das Erdgeschoss ein. Direkt darüber liegen die Räume der Schwedischen Akademie. Alfred Nobel gab dem Preis seinen Namen, und der Preis gab ihn dem Museum. Alles zusammen an einem Platz in der Altstadt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The museum opened in 2001, the year the Nobel Prize turned one hundred. Its home is the Börshuset on Stortorget, and it takes the ground floor. Directly above are the rooms of the Swedish Academy. Alfred Nobel gave his name to the prize, and the prize gave its name to the museum. All of it on one square in the old town.

localizedStory.de: Das Nobelpreismuseum liegt im Erdgeschoss am Stortorget, und ein Stockwerk höher arbeitet die Schwedische Akademie.
localizedStory.en: The Nobel Prize Museum takes the ground floor on Stortorget, and the Swedish Academy works on the floor above.

fruits.name: Nobelprismuseet
fruits.story: The Nobel Prize Museum takes the ground floor on Stortorget, and the Swedish Academy works on the floor above.

fruits.extendedStory: The house of the Swedish nobility went up from 1674, to plans by Simon de la Vallée. Outside it is calm and classical, a straight face on a square. Inside, the walls of the great hall carry 2,332 coats of arms, one for each noble family. Look up, and the whole room is shields, rank above rank.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Haus des schwedischen Adels entstand ab 1674, nach Plänen von Simon de la Vallée. Von außen ist es ruhig und klassisch, ein glattes Gesicht am Platz. Drinnen tragen die Wände des großen Saals 2.332 Wappen, eines für jedes Adelsgeschlecht. Wer den Kopf hebt, sieht nur Schilde, Reihe über Reihe.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The house of the Swedish nobility went up from 1674, to plans by Simon de la Vallée. Outside it is calm and classical, a straight face on a square. Inside, the walls of the great hall carry 2,332 coats of arms, one for each noble family. Look up, and the whole room is shields, rank above rank.

localizedStory.de: Drinnen bedecken 2.332 Adelswappen die Wände des großen Saals.
localizedStory.en: Inside, 2,332 noble coats of arms cover the walls of a single hall.

fruits.name: Riddarhuset
fruits.story: Inside, 2,332 noble coats of arms cover the walls of a single hall.

fruits.extendedStory: On 8 March 1571 King Johan III promised his German-born subjects a church of their own. They were given the plot of a former Dominican monastery, and this is what stands on it. On the night of 6 October 1878 a fire in the tower took the bells, the carillon and the organ. All of it came back. Every Wednesday at half past three the organist climbs up and plays the 37 bells by hand.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Am 8. März 1571 versprach König Johan III. seinen in Deutschland geborenen Untertanen eine eigene Kirche. Sie bekamen das Grundstück des früheren Dominikanerklosters, und darauf steht dieser Bau. In der Nacht zum 7. Oktober 1878 brannte der Turm, mit den Glocken, dem Glockenspiel und der Orgel. Alles kam zurück. Jeden Mittwoch um halb vier steigt der Organist hinauf und spielt die 37 Glocken von Hand.
localizedExtendedStory.en: On 8 March 1571 King Johan III promised his German-born subjects a church of their own. They were given the plot of a former Dominican monastery, and this is what stands on it. On the night of 6 October 1878 a fire in the tower took the bells, the carillon and the organ. All of it came back. Every Wednesday at half past three the organist climbs up and plays the 37 bells by hand.

localizedStory.de: Um acht, zwölf, sechzehn und zwanzig Uhr spielt das Glockenspiel einen Choral, so wie seit 1666.
localizedStory.en: At eight, twelve, four and eight in the evening the bells play a chorale, as they have since 1666.

fruits.name: Tyska kyrkan
fruits.story: At eight, twelve, four and eight in the evening the bells play a chorale, as they have since 1666.

fruits.extendedStory: Tessin built it between 1694 and about 1700 as a home for himself and his own family. The plot is no larger than an ordinary villa plot in Stockholm today. So what he put on it is a palace in miniature, grand in every detail and small in every measure. Since 1968 it has been the residence of the county governor of Stockholm.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Zwischen 1694 und etwa 1700 baute Tessin das Haus für sich und seine Familie. Das Grundstück ist nicht größer als ein gewöhnliches Villengrundstück im heutigen Stockholm. Also stellte er darauf ein Palais in Miniatur, im Detail groß und im Maß klein. Seit 1968 wohnt hier der Landeshauptmann von Stockholm.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Tessin built it between 1694 and about 1700 as a home for himself and his own family. The plot is no larger than an ordinary villa plot in Stockholm today. So what he put on it is a palace in miniature, grand in every detail and small in every measure. Since 1968 it has been the residence of the county governor of Stockholm.

localizedStory.de: Nicodemus Tessin der Jüngere baute dieses Palais für sich selbst, auf einem Grundstück nicht größer als ein normales Wohngrundstück.
localizedStory.en: Nicodemus Tessin the Younger built this palace for himself, on a plot no larger than an ordinary house lot.

fruits.name: Tessinska palatset
fruits.story: Nicodemus Tessin the Younger built this palace for himself, on a plot no larger than an ordinary house lot.

fruits.extendedStory: By tradition the house opened in 1722, though it says itself that the learned still argue about the year. The name points at a peace treaty, maybe Stettin, maybe Nystad. In 1780 Bellman put it in print, as one of the cellars where Movitz went hunting a cure for fever and hiccups. Then in 1919 Anders Zorn heard over a plate of meatballs that it was closing, and bought it instead.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Überlieferung nach öffnete das Haus 1722, doch es sagt selbst, dass die Gelehrten über das Jahr streiten. Der Name deutet auf einen Friedensschluss, vielleicht Stettin, vielleicht Nystad. 1780 brachte Bellman es in Druck, als einen der Keller, in denen Movitz ein Mittel gegen Fieber und Schluckauf suchte. 1919 hörte Anders Zorn bei einem Teller Fleischbällchen, dass geschlossen werden sollte, und kaufte es kurzerhand.
localizedExtendedStory.en: By tradition the house opened in 1722, though it says itself that the learned still argue about the year. The name points at a peace treaty, maybe Stettin, maybe Nystad. In 1780 Bellman put it in print, as one of the cellars where Movitz went hunting a cure for fever and hiccups. Then in 1919 Anders Zorn heard over a plate of meatballs that it was closing, and bought it instead.

localizedStory.de: Ein Maler kaufte dieses Wirtshaus 1919, damit es nicht schließt, und sein Testament hält Fleischbällchen für immer auf der Karte.
localizedStory.en: A painter bought this tavern in 1919 so it would not close, and his will keeps meatballs on the menu forever.

fruits.name: Den Gyldene Freden
fruits.story: A painter bought this tavern in 1919 so it would not close, and his will keeps meatballs on the menu forever.

fruits.extendedStory: A Franciscan priory stood on this island from 1270, and its church is the one medieval abbey Stockholm still has. Every Swedish monarch from Gustav II Adolf to Gustaf V rests here, except Queen Kristina. Seventeen of them, up to 1950. It is not a parish church, so no one is christened or married here. The building has one job, and it has kept it a long time.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Seit 1270 stand auf dieser Insel ein Franziskanerkloster, und seine Kirche ist das einzige erhaltene mittelalterliche Kloster Stockholms. Jeder schwedische Monarch von Gustav II. Adolf bis Gustaf V. ruht hier, außer Königin Kristina. Siebzehn sind es, bis 1950. Eine Gemeindekirche ist sie nicht, es wird hier weder getauft noch geheiratet. Das Haus hat eine einzige Aufgabe und erfüllt sie seit langem.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A Franciscan priory stood on this island from 1270, and its church is the one medieval abbey Stockholm still has. Every Swedish monarch from Gustav II Adolf to Gustaf V rests here, except Queen Kristina. Seventeen of them, up to 1950. It is not a parish church, so no one is christened or married here. The building has one job, and it has kept it a long time.

localizedStory.de: Das einzige erhaltene mittelalterliche Kloster Stockholms, und drinnen ruhen siebzehn schwedische Monarchen.
localizedStory.en: Stockholm's only medieval abbey still standing, and seventeen Swedish monarchs rest inside.

fruits.name: Riddarholmskyrkan
fruits.story: Stockholm's only medieval abbey still standing, and seventeen Swedish monarchs rest inside.
